messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: wholesale issue closing
parts:
I'm OK with closing all these issues, but I don't want
the information to be lost. Would everyone closing
issues that haven't been resolved but are still of
interest please move the contents to the longer-term
issues document or create a new projects doc?

Thanks.

- Bob

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] wholesale issue closing
parts:
Yup. I can make a list of all the ones I've closed recently without resolution on a wiki page.

And we can put projects somewhere too.



Daniel

P.S. Sorry, would have done that with the pass that I made, but my computer was dead. I had an hour to kill, so I just walked through issues yo make use of my time.
